detail.body:
Backport of #6419 to `r0.7.0`, cherry-picked from `b1bb0a97ec5aad323eb2dd666e3f69aaebc1daff` without conflicts. The backport patch ID matches the merged source commit.

Renames the Vera Rubin NVL72 GPU type and performance recipes from `vr200` to `vrnvl72`. Existing `--gpu vr200` and `_vr200_` CLI recipe names remain deprecated aliases. Direct Python imports of the old modules and recipe functions must migrate to the new names.

Validation:
- All pre-commit hooks passed using `uv run --no-project --with pre-commit pre-commit run --all-files`. Standard project execution is blocked by the uninitialized Megatron-Core submodule in the isolated worktree.
- Focused torch-free launcher tests: 138 passed, 1 failed. `test_known_cross_package_collisions_have_explicit_benchmark_precedence` also fails on the unchanged `r0.7.0` baseline with the same unregistered `nemotron_3_super_pretrain_64gpu_gb200_bf16_config` collision.
- `git diff --cached --check` passed.
- GPU-dependent tests were not run locally.
